messages:
Maya: Quick, 1-question poll — you get one extra free morning minute. Do you use it to snooze/wake up later (lie-in) or to actually watch the sunrise and get up early? Say your vote + 1-line reason.
Jamal: Sunrise — coffee + colors = instant mood boost :sunrise:
Ana: Lie-in. I am not functional before caffeine + 20 mins more sleep. :sleeping:
Ravi: Sunrise on weekends, otherwise lie-in. But if forced to pick: sunrise for the walk.
Lena: Lie-in. I value an extra 10–15 mins under the duvet. sorry not sorry. :pleading_face:
Elliot: Sunrise — it’s a tiny ritual that feels like I earned the day. Also good photos. :camera_flash:
Coffee-Bot: Brewing stats: 3x sunrise votes, 2x lie-in. Suggestion: sunrise + pour-over = bliss (6:45 ready).
Maya: Current tally 3 sunrise / 2 lie-in. Keep 'em coming — include a micro-ritual if you picked sunrise, or a pro snooze move if you picked lie-in.
Tina: Both? But if forced: lie-in + set alarm for 7:00 and allow exactly one snooze — then up. Works surprisingly well. :alarm_clock:
Jamal: Micro-ritual for sunrise = 2-min silence on the balcony, no phone. super grounding.
Ana: Pro snooze move: put phone on the other side of the room so the snooze actually requires movement.
Ravi: Weekend sunrise ritual: 10-min jog to a hill + instant black coffee.
Lena: Also, blackout curtains + small lamp timer makes waking less brutal if you want to emulate sunrise.
Elliot: This is now the official Redwood micro-morning thread. We should put this on the 'micro-rituals' wiki. :raised_hands:
Maya: Love the ideas. Tiny follow-up: who actually gets out of bed to watch an IRL sunrise more than once a month? Reply with yes/no.
Jamal: yes — at least twice a month in summer.
Ana: no — maybe on vacations.
Ravi: yes on hikes. no on weekdays.
Lena: no.
Elliot: yes-ish. Weekend-only.
Tina: no but will try the one-snooze rule tomorrow. Report back. :sweat_smile:
Coffee-Bot: Reminder scheduled: Tomorrow 06:40 — "Tiny sunrise watch + pour-over?" (opt-in)
Maya: Thanks everyone. Results: casual majority sunrise among volunteers, but lie-in wins on weekdays. Thread closed, carry on with your morning experiments. :sun_with_face:
